Container.Name: meme-arr
Container.Overview: Turn any moment in your Plex or Jellyfin library into a meme. Search dialogue, trim the clip, burn in subtitles or your own caption, and export WebP, MP4, WebM or GIF.
Container.Description:
meme-arr indexes the subtitles of your Plex or Jellyfin library so you can search for a line of dialogue, jump to that exact moment, and export a captioned clip.
**Setup:** open the WebUI, set an admin password, then follow the wizard to enter your Plex/Jellyfin address and token. The wizard asks where each library folder is mounted inside this container. Mounting your media at the same path your media server uses makes this easiest.
The media share is mounted read-only. Finished memes are written to the Output path.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: meme plex jellyfin subtitles gif arr

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, subtitle index and preview cache. Keep this.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media library (read-only). Must be the same files Plex/Jellyfin plays.

Config.Name: Fonts
Config.Description: Optional: drop an Impact.ttf (case sensative) here to use the classic meme font

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as. Must be able to read your media.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: Index on start
Config.Description: Scan libraries on first start. Afterwards System, then Tasks, controls the schedule.
